2607.26464.title: PUDA: An AI-Native Hardware Harness for Self-Driving Laboratories
2607.26464.paper_summary: Physical Unified Device Architecture (PUDA) is an AI-native hardware harness for self-driving laboratories (SDLs). Rather than building a human-centered graphical user interface (GUI) orchestration layer, PUDA creates a command-line runtime environment that lets agents observe, orient, decide, and act over experiments while hardware execution remains deterministic, atomic, and auditable. Headless by design, devices appear through discoverable command-line interfaces, JSON protocols are routed through a distributed messaging system, and command responses, data products, and reports are preserved as structured records. PUDA organizes protocols, runs, samples, measurements, and command logs into an AI-native data structure linked by run identifiers and timestamps, preserving provenance from submitted protocol through hardware response to resulting data products. PUDA separates scientific orchestration from physical operation and data telemetry: agents choose experiments, while PUDA executes validated commands and captures provenance-linked state, responses, and data. The contribution is not another optimizer, orchestrator, or recipe language. It is a practical execution and data environment for agentic SDLs; the broader physical AI implication is that PUDA provides an AI-native hardware harness for AI systems to interact with physical tools.
2607.26464.paper_summary_zh: 物理統一裝置架構（PUDA）是一種針對自駕實驗室（SDL）的AI原生硬體架構。PUDA並不是建立以人為中心的圖形使用者介面（GUI）協調層，而是創建了一個命令列執行環境，讓代理可以在實驗中觀察、定位、決策和行動，同時硬體執行保持確定性、原子性和可審計性。PUDA設計為無頭，裝置透過可發現的命令列介面顯示，JSON協議通過分散式消息系統路由，而命令回應、數據產品和報告則保留為結構化記錄。PUDA將協議、運行、樣本、測量和命令日誌組織成一種由運行識別碼和時間戳鏈接的AI原生數據結構，保留從提交的協議到硬體回應再到結果數據產品的來源。PUDA將科學協調與物理操作和數據遙測分開：代理選擇實驗，而PUDA執行經過驗證的命令並捕獲與來源相關的狀態、回應和數據。其貢獻不是另一個優化器、協調器或食譜語言。它是一個針對代理SDL的實用執行和數據環境；更廣泛的物理AI意涵是，PUDA為AI系統與物理工具互動提供了一種AI原生硬體架構。
